entities.summary: The Croatian Peasant Party is an agrarian political party in Croatia founded on 22 December 1904 by Antun and Stjepan Radić as Croatian Peoples' Peasant Party (HPSS). The Brothers Radić believed that the realization of Croatian statehood was possible within Austria-Hungary, but that it had to be reformed as a monarchy divided into three equal parts – Austria, Hungary, and Croatia. After the creation of Kingdom of Yugoslavia in 1918, the party requested self-determination for the Croatian part of the kingdom.
